budgetChangeLedger.owner: stasis / embedded image codecs / worker supervision
budgetChangeLedger.reason: Post-0.11.0 trains raised the default and iroh closures by nine unique pairs: Stasis 0.12 brought grapheme-wasm, locus-surreal-adapter, and sse-stream; embedded image codecs added gif, image-webp, and color_quant; worker supervision added process-wrap and nix, plus a second base64. genai 0.5.3 left the graph. Duplicate-version counts stayed put. Stasis 0.13.0, locus-sdk 0.5.0, and h2 0.4.19 replace existing versions and do not add pairs.
budgetChangeLedger.evidence: cargo tree -p medousa compared at 720ba839 (0.11.0 ceiling) and 19938039; CI run 36429400161

budgetChangeLedger.workload: P09 medousa-default, medousa-iroh-transport, and adapter-workspace for 0.11.0 companions
budgetChangeLedger.reason: medousa-work joins the default and iroh daemon closures as the durable unit-of-work crate and adds one unique pair (its other dependencies were already present). The Slack adapter stores its intake inbox beside the daemon data dir via dirs 6, which pulls dirs-sys and option-ext into the adapter closure only. async-trait 0.1.92 drops the bare must_use that Rust 1.99 clippy rejects as double_must_use; that release depends on syn 3, one new pair in each measured closure. Duplicate-version name counts are unchanged because syn was already duplicated.
budgetChangeLedger.oldNew: 946->948 default; 1021->1023 iroh; 251->255 adapter; duplicate-version counts unchanged
budgetChangeLedger.evidence: cargo tree -e normal compared with main 46fae42d; async-trait 0.1.92 release notes (dtolnay/async-trait#303)

budgetChangeLedger.workload: P09 medousa-default and medousa-iroh-transport for the 0.12.0 tag
budgetChangeLedger.reason: Stable cargo's normal tree of main 93c7e47 already counts 959 unique pairs and 93 duplicate-version names (hashlink and nix are both duplicated; genai collapsed to one version). The 2026-10-05 ceilings were 11 pairs and 1 duplicate name lower, and rust-deps never reached this check because cargo deny failed first. Advisory updates replace ammonia, rustls 0.23, rustls-webpki 0.103, webpki-roots 1.x, ctutils, and webpki-root-certs in place. Windows-only zip 9 is outside this Linux measurement.
budgetChangeLedger.oldNew: 948->959 default; 1023->1034 iroh; duplicate-version names 92->93 default and 99->100 iroh
budgetChangeLedger.evidence: cargo tree --locked -p medousa -e normal on main 93c7e47 versus this branch; scripts/ci/check-dependency-budget.py

budgetChangeLedger.workload: P09 adapter-workspace after the tokio 1.54.1 advisory bump
budgetChangeLedger.reason: tokio 1.54.1 (RUSTSEC-2026-0386) pulls socket2 0.5.10 into the telegram, discord, and slack closure, which already contains socket2 0.6.3. That is one new unique pair and one new duplicate-version name. The default and iroh closures already contained both socket2 versions, so their ceilings stay put. socket2 is already on the default duplicate-name list.

budgetChangeLedger.evidence: cargo tree --locked -p medousa-telegram -p medousa-discord -p medousa-slack -e normal at a498934f (255/20) versus 87a2b26e (256/21)
